title: Stdlib parts library (fasteners + bearings)
summary: New parametric parts library: bolts (M2–M12 ISO 4762), hex nuts, flat washers, 608 skate bearings. Parts remain editable after insertion and round-trip through save/load. McMaster, ISO, and DIN catalog numbers cross-referenced on every part. New chat + MCP tools `search_parts` and `place_part`.
